استخبرا (form X)
# اِسْتَخْبَرَا (istaḵbarā) /is.tax.ba.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# اُسْتُخْبِرَا (ustuḵbirā) /us.tux.bi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# اِسْتَخْبِرَا (istaḵbirā) /is.tax.bi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
